# Parse all notes to extract date and habit values
import re
from datetime import datetime

habit_order = None
rows = []

for note in note_contents:
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    m = re.search(r'for (\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', note['title'])
    if not m:
        continue
    date_str = m.group(1)
    # Parse content lines
    content = note['content']
    lines = content.split('\n')
    # Find lines with habit: yes/no
    habits = {}
    for line in lines:
        line = line.strip()
        if ':' in line:
            parts = line.split(':', 1)
            if len(parts) == 2:
                habit = parts[0].strip()
                value = parts[1].strip().lower()
                if value in ('yes', 'no'):
                    habits[habit] = value
    if not habits:
        continue
    # If first note, set habit_order
    if habit_order is None:
        habit_order = list(habits.keys())
    rows.append({'date': date_str, 'habits': habits})

print(f"Number of rows: {len(rows)}")
print("Habit order:", habit_order)
print("First row:", rows[0])
